notes.title: Game Update n°3
notes.notes:
[b]Thanks to your feedback on the demo, the game is updated![/b]

[u]A quick update on the changes:[/u]
- The scoring system was flawed, now you won't always end up in S rank, unless you're an exceptional player. Are you up for the challenge?
- We've increased the life points recovered thanks to the life potion, we're not beasts after all.
- The HealPod object that you win after finishing the first level gives you back life AND hurts enemies.
- Various fixes that we have the secret to lol

notes.title: Increase Soap's Comblade damage & Bug fix
notes.notes:
We know you want power ! So...

Following your feedback we have decided to increase the power of the Comblade and we have corrected some bugs following your first game sessions. 



Do not hesitate to join the discord to give us your feedback so that we can improve the game.
